name: psk_mod_qpsk_sps4
description: psk_mod: differential Gray QPSK, 4 samples per symbol, RRC 0.35

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio shapes with pfb_arb_resampler_ccf; at an integer samples per symbol dividing 32 its arms hit the same taps as an interpolating FIR (every 32/sps-th prototype tap), so only float32 summation order differs: about 33 terms of values below 1.2 (ulp 1.2e-7), measured 1e-6.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: RRC taps (prototype of gain 32 decimated, peak 1.09, so Q2.14) rounded: error 2^-15 per tap, 45 taps per output, symbols below 0.71 per component for QPSK: 45 * 2^-15 * 0.71 = 1e-3 per component and 1.4e-3 in magnitude; the Q14 constellation points (2^-15) and output rounding (2^-15) add 1e-4 per component. Bound 2e-3.
